preconditions.description: T is an integer between 1 and 50 inclusive, representing the number of test cases.

preconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == 5 for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip())
preconditions.description: Each match line has exactly 5 space-separated tokens: HomeTeamName, HomeTeamGoals, 'vs.', AwayTeamGoals, AwayTeamName.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(goals) <= 100 for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() for goals in [line.split()[1], line.split()[3]])
preconditions.description: HomeTeamGoals and AwayTeamGoals are integers between 0 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(team_name) <= 10 and team_name.islower() and team_name.isalpha() for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() for team_name in [line.split()[0], line.split()[4]])
preconditions.description: Team names are lowercase alphabetic strings of length 1 to 10.

postconditions.expression: all(len(output_line.split()) == 2 for output_line in stdout.splitlines() if output_line.strip())
postconditions.description: Each output line contains exactly two space-separated team names.

postconditions.expression: all(team1 != team2 for output_line in stdout.splitlines() if output_line.strip() for team1, team2 in [output_line.split()])
postconditions.description: The two team names in each output line are distinct.

postconditions.expression: all(team1 in teams and team2 in teams for output_line in stdout.splitlines() if output_line.strip() for team1, team2 in [output_line.split()] for teams in [set(line.split()[0] for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip()) | set(line.split()[4] for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip())])
postconditions.description: The two team names in each output line are valid teams from the input.

postconditions.expression: all(team1_points > team2_points or (team1_points == team2_points and team1_goal_diff > team2_goal_diff) for output_line in stdout.splitlines() if output_line.strip() for team1, team2 in [output_line.split()] for team1_points, team1_goal_diff in [get_team_stats(team1)] for team2_points, team2_goal_diff in [get_team_stats(team2)])
postconditions.description: The first team in the output line has strictly more points than the second team, or if points are equal, a strictly higher goal difference.

postconditions.expression: all(team1_points >= team2_points >= team3_points >= team4_points for teams in [get_teams_in_test_case()] for team1, team2, team3, team4 in [sorted(teams, key=lambda t: (-get_team_stats(t)[0], -get_team_stats(t)[1]))] for team1_points, _ in [get_team_stats(team1)] for team2_points, _ in [get_team_stats(team2)])
postconditions.description: The first team in the output line is the top-ranked team, and the second team is the second top-ranked team, based on points and goal difference.
